tools.name: company_signals
tools.description: Joined company signals for one US ticker, each linked to its public source: SEC 8-K/13D/insider events, state WARN layoff and closure notices (CA, NY, TX, WA, NJ), public job-board hiring counts and federal contract awards (USAspending, last 12 months). Optional since= for only new facts. $0.01 per

tools.name: signals_search
tools.description: Search all company signals with typed filters: layer, type, state, ticker, min/max contract amount, min worker or role count, event date range, first-seen since (change log), closure, matched, min match confidence and text. Every row has a source link. $0.03 per call.

tools.name: company_dossier
tools.description: Full company dossier: identifiers (CIK, tickers, federal recipient UEIs with match confidence, job boards), per-layer summaries (SEC, WARN, hiring trend, contracts by agency), recent postings, a 30-day change log and every fact with its source link. $0.25 per call.

tools.name: sample
tools.description: Free: what is covered, real example rows from each layer, fact types and prices.

tools.name: health
tools.description: Free: service status, fact counts and last ingest runs.
